# Random chance to trigger an action

Source: [4823](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4823); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4823-n1"></a>

- Documented 1-in-N action recipe uses If(Random Integer(1,N)==1) around actions and closes with End; any fixed integer in the inclusive range works.

Source limitations:

- Source's introductory statement that If compares two values for equality is overspecific; general If takes a condition.

- Archived example is a per-evaluation chance, not a time-based probability; frequency depends on surrounding execution.
